nodes.label: The Flat and the People Form
nodes.norm_label: the flat and the people form
nodes.rationale: Card with Property text input (placeholder '2BHK, Kotturpuram - flat 3B') and native Move-out date picker.

nodes.label: ExitKit Header and Tagline
nodes.rationale: Green 'ExitKit' wordmark with tagline 'Move out without the deposit fight.'

nodes.label: Local-Only Data Privacy Promise
nodes.rationale: Footnote 'Everything stays on this phone. No account, no upload.' - on-device storage, no backend or login.

nodes.label: Roommates and Deposit Contributions
nodes.rationale: 'Roommates and who paid what deposit' section with '+ Add roommate' outline button; feeds the per-roommate deposit settlement math.

nodes.label: ExitKit Setup Screen (1179x2556)
nodes.rationale: iPhone-sized (1179x2556) store-style screenshot of step 1 of the move-out walkthrough; single white card on light gray background, dark green brand color, mostly empty space below the card.

nodes.label: Step Navigation Bar (1 Setup)
nodes.rationale: Horizontally scrolling pill step bar with active '1 Setup'; a visible scrollbar suggests other steps overflow off-screen (possible layout polish issue).

nodes.label: Teal-Green Brand Color
nodes.rationale: Two-tone dark teal (~#0F6B5A outer, ~#0C5E4E inner) conveys stability and reassurance.

nodes.label: ExitKit App Icon
nodes.rationale: Deep teal-green rounded-square app icon with a flat white glyph; calm, trustworthy, finance/admin tone rather than playful.

nodes.label: Checkmark Completion Badge
nodes.rationale: Circular badge with teal checkmark overlapping the panel corner: signals tasks done / exit handled, matching a guided walkthrough to completion.

nodes.label: Document/Form Panel Mark
nodes.rationale: White rounded panel split into a header row of two cells over a body: reads as a form, table or paperwork pack (the exit/settlement document pack).

nodes.label: RevenueCat Test Store
nodes.rationale: Demo purchase is a genuine SDK purchase and entitlement grant with no real charges, not a fake modal.

nodes.label: On-Device Privacy (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Everything lives on device; no account, cloud, or upload. Auth, cloud sync, OCR, AI, legal advice deliberately cut to keep build honest; ExitKit records agreements, does not arbitrate.

nodes.label: One-Time Non-Consumable Purchase Model
nodes.rationale: No subscription on purpose: move-out is episodic and high-value; paywall sits exactly where value is (the shareable PDF pack). Walkthrough, ledger, math, and preview stay free.

nodes.label: Deposit Settlement (Integer Paise)
nodes.rationale: Integer paise arithmetic with fixed-order rounding distribution so every phone shows identical numbers; avoids float drift and 'your app cheated' disputes.

nodes.label: Four Room Templates
nodes.rationale: Fixed set (bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, living room) to keep scope tight.
